top_signal.title: Mailbox shop owner is getting close quickly
top_signal.summary: I needed a business address to set up my LLC , the Indian business owner of the small postal shop offered to help me set up my LLC and so that he had a lot of experience and business ownership but that has postal shop business is not successful in the way that he thought it would be. I met him today at a coffee shop because he wanted to show me a CRM AI that he created.   Something in the back of my head is telling me there's something going wrong here but I'm more of a paranoid business owner who doesn't trust anybody so I am trying to be more trustworthy of people who are genuinely offering help and may have resources I don't and may also be potential great partners   My first mistake was using an account on the crm to purchase my domain name. I pay for 10 years up front because I'm paranoid somebody's going to mess with my domain in the future. I know the gentleman is a little bit older and this AI is something that he's been building for a while. The payment for my domain went through his credit card because he wanted to help by making my account I guess in advance for me partially so that I can log in quickly. It could be an honest mistake but also I am extremely serious about who pays for what that's related to the most important aspects of my business. This Indian man has now paid for my domain.
